value.rationale: Collective squared displacement is the natural one-time energy/extent of the entire confined gas. Its rare excursions above the equilibrium variance are invisible to a bulk conditional-iid law; the exact \(N^{-b/2}\) critical scaling and \(N^{-b-1/2}\) off-critical prefactor show how the reset rate remains measurable even when the leading large-deviation rate is independent of it. Exact coefficients can guide finite-size experiments and theoretical comparisons.
